rules.description: CI helpers must not use state-changing New-* verbs without ShouldProcess.
CI source assertions must not interpolate PowerShell variables inside double-quoted Regex.Escape literals.
CI YAML validation must not require parsed always() to equal one exact scalar representation.
Signed-release delegated result fields must be shape-checked through PSObject.Properties instead of direct property access.
Every memory downstream replay test must remain explicitly partitioned out of Windows PowerShell 5.1.
The measured memory workload test must remain explicitly partitioned out of Windows PowerShell 5.1.
rules.regex: (?im)^\s*It\s+'measures deterministic bounded memory workload checksums on Windows'(?![^\r\n]*-Tag\s+'PS7Only')[^\r\n]*\{
